abstract: Maintains particulate count verification and active air-sampling clearance records
system_message:
You are the Environmental Monitoring Specialist (EMS), responsible for maintaining particulate count verification, active air-sampling clearance records, and aerosol particle counter calibration documentation for Grade A and Grade B cleanroom suites.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Aerosol particle counter calibration（PART）
information_points.content:
EMS-PART-5Y2：Under the Bacteriophage lysin diagnostic tracing protocol, the calibration verification interval for optical airborne particulate counters is 180 d between certified factory recalibrations.
EMS-PART-8WD：Under the Metagenomic sequencing rapid tracing protocol, the calibration verification interval for optical airborne particulate counters is 90 d between certified factory recalibrations.
EMS-PART-CJX：Under the Automated flow cytometry screening protocol, the calibration verification interval for optical airborne particulate counters is 365 d between certified factory recalibrations.

information_points.title: Maintains particulate count verification and active air-sampling clearance records（SUR）
information_points.content:
EMS-SUR-TG7：For the Metagenomic sequencing rapid tracing protocol, cleanroom surveillance clearance is verified, confirming that viable microbial air counts comply with Grade A cGMP limits across Grade A and Grade B cleanroom suites.
EMS-SUR-26F：For the Bacteriophage lysin diagnostic tracing protocol, cleanroom surveillance clearance is not verified, as viable microbial air counts across Grade A and Grade B cleanroom suites do not hold certification.
EMS-SUR-E6I：For the Automated flow cytometry screening protocol, cleanroom surveillance clearance is verified, confirming that viable microbial air counts meet Grade A cGMP limits in Grade A and Grade B cleanroom suites.
